kanke-road.name: Kanke Road
kanke-road.about:
Kanke Road runs north from central Ranchi, one of the two roads that fork off Circular Road beyond Kutchery, the other being Ratu Road. Homes along it and in the colonies behind it, such as Jawahar Nagar, Indrapuri Colony, Hatma and Gandhi Nagar Colony, are a mix of older independent houses and newer apartment buildings, many offering three-bedroom flats. Morabadi lies to the east, and the road continues out towards Kanke and the Kanke Dam reservoir.

Residents rate the area well for public transport and easy auto and cab availability, with markets close to most homes. The Kanke–Patratu Road and the Ranchi Ring Road link the northern end to the rest of the city. For a tutor, doorstep visits to independent houses are simple, while apartment buildings usually ask visitors to sign in at the gate. Evening sessions are easier to keep on time if the tutor avoids the office rush on Kanke Road itself. Families wanting a specialist board or subject tutor can combine home visits with online classes. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

morabadi.name: Morabadi
morabadi.about:
Morabadi, also spelt Morhabadi, is a residential neighbourhood in north-east Ranchi known for the large Morabadi ground and its sports facilities and parks. Homes here are mostly apartment buildings with two- and three-bedroom flats, alongside older houses in colonies such as Van Vrindavan Colony, Adalhatu Colony and Dipatoli. Neighbouring areas include Chiraundi, Kanke Road, Bariatu and Rani Bagan.

The area is reached by Morabadi Road, Circular Road, Karamtoli Road, the Kanke–Patratu Road and the Bajra–Bariatu Road, so a tutor coming from Lalpur, Bariatu or Kanke Road has several routes to choose from. Residents mention markets within walking distance and well-kept roads. Apartment buildings normally keep a visitor register at the gate, so it helps to share the tutor's name in advance. On days when the ground hosts a large event, roads around it fill up, and families may prefer an online session instead of a home visit. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

bariatu.name: Bariatu
bariatu.about:
Bariatu is a residential locality in north-east Ranchi, covering Bariatu Road, Bariatu Housing Colony, Rani Bagan, Jora Talab and Sarhul Nagar. Housing is dominated by ready apartment buildings with three-bedroom flats built by city-based developers, along with residential plots and older houses in the housing colony. Morabadi is the neighbouring area to the west, and the Kokar and Namkum industrial areas are within easy reach to the south.

The Bajra–Bariatu Road and Joda Talab Road are the main connecting roads, and residents rate connectivity highly, with good public transport and easy cab and auto availability. Roads in and around Bariatu get busy at peak hours, so after-school tutor visits work better when timed before the evening rush. Many families live in apartment blocks with gate registration, while the housing colony has doorstep access to individual houses. Students preparing for competitive exams often mix a local home tutor with online sessions for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

lalpur.name: Lalpur
lalpur.about:
Lalpur is a commercial and residential district at the centre of Ranchi, built around Lalpur Chowk, where Circular Road meets Old Hazaribagh Road. Together with Hindpiri, Upper Bazar, Lower Bazar and Doranda, it is one of the city's main business areas, with shopping complexes, hotels, clinics and offices. Residential pockets such as Burdwan Compound, Lower Burdwan Compound and the BSNL colony sit close to the chowk, and Kantatoli lies nearby.

Homes are a mix of apartment buildings and older independent houses in compounds and lanes. Autos and e-rickshaws run through much of the day, and Ranchi Junction is close by, which makes Lalpur easy to reach for tutors from across the city. Roads around the chowk are busy for long stretches of the day, so fixed session times slightly away from the office and market rush help. Parking near the main roads is limited, so tutors often arrive by auto or e-rickshaw for the last leg. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kokar.name: Kokar
kokar.about:
Kokar is a busy mixed locality in east Ranchi, known as one of the city's industrial areas managed by the state industrial development authority and home to several company head offices, including a newspaper group. Around the commercial core are residential pockets such as Tiril Basti, Bank Colony and Vasuki Nagar, where housing is mostly mid-income apartment buildings with two-bedroom flats, plus older houses.

Kokar sits on the Ranchi–Patna road and Hazaribagh Road, with Tiril Road and Durgapuri Road as local connectors, and Old Hazaribagh Road leads towards Ranchi Junction. Namkon and Ranchi Junction are the nearest railway stations. The Kantatoli flyover, opened in October 2024, carries traffic from the Kokar side over the Kantatoli junction towards Bahu Bazar, which has made cross-town trips easier. For tutors, apartment blocks usually need gate registration, and evening sessions are easier to keep on time when planned around the peak rush on the main roads. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

namkum.name: Namkum
namkum.about:
Namkum is on the south-eastern edge of Ranchi and gives its name to a community development block in the Ranchi Sadar subdivision. Alongside one of the city's established industrial areas, it has growing residential pockets such as Barganwa, Tetry Toli and Amethiya Nagar. Housing is a mix of residential plots, independent houses and newer gated apartment enclaves, many with three-bedroom flats. Residents describe it as quieter and greener than the city centre.

Namkon railway station, on the Gomoh–Hatia line, serves the area, and roads through Doranda link Namkum to the rest of the city and the airport side. Kokar and Bariatu are the nearest larger localities to the north. Because homes are more spread out here, tutors often travel by their own two-wheeler, and houses offer easy doorstep access while gated enclaves ask for visitor details at the gate. Families on the outer edge who want a particular subject specialist may find online classes a practical option alongside a home tutor. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

harmu.name: Harmu
harmu.about:
Harmu, centred on Harmu Housing Colony, is one of the largest residential areas of Ranchi. The colony was set up in the early 1960s and has grown steadily, so it now has independent houses, newer high-rise apartment buildings with mostly three-bedroom flats, shops and government offices. Its neighbours are Argora and Ashok Nagar to the south, Kishoreganj to the north and the New AG Cooperative Colony to the east, with Chaputoli and Dhipatoli close by.

The colony lies along Bypass Road, also called Harmu Road, and is also reached by Argora Road, Pundag Road, the Kadru–Kumhartoli Road and AG Colony Road. Argora railway station is the nearest station, and Ranchi Junction is not far via Station Road. For tutors, the housing colony's independent houses allow doorstep visits with street parking, while newer apartment buildings usually need gate registration. The Bypass Road gets busy around office hours, so evening sessions are easier to keep on time with some buffer. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

argora.name: Argora
argora.about:
Argora is a residential locality in west-central Ranchi, next to Harmu, Chaputoli and Dhipatoli, with Ashok Nagar and Pundag nearby. It has its own railway station on the Ranchi division of the South Eastern Railway, which also serves the surrounding colonies. Housing is a mix of older independent houses and gated apartment societies, with some residential plots still being developed.

Argora Chowk is the local focal point, and the road from Argora Chowk towards Kathal More carries much of the local traffic. Bypass Road links the area towards Hinoo and the airport side. Residents note congestion at peak hours, so tutors travelling here in the evening do well to arrive a little early or pick a slot after the office rush. Apartment societies generally register visitors at the gate, while houses in the older lanes allow doorstep access. Families can mix in-person lessons with online sessions for specialist subjects or exam practice. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ashok-nagar.name: Ashok Nagar
ashok-nagar.about:
Ashok Nagar is a planned residential colony in west Ranchi, set up in 1975 as a cooperative housing society by senior state government employees. It is laid out in plots, so much of the housing is independent houses, with newer apartment buildings offering three-bedroom flats appearing over time. Harmu Housing Colony, Ashok Vihar and Ashok Kunj are its immediate neighbours, and Argora lies close by.

Residents rate the colony well for cleanliness and easy cab and auto availability. Bypass Road connects Ashok Nagar towards the airport side and the rest of the city, and Argora and Ranchi Junction are the nearest railway stations. Because most homes are plotted houses on internal colony roads, a tutor can usually reach the doorstep directly and park nearby, while apartment buildings may ask for a name at the gate. For exam-year students, families often pair a local home tutor with online sessions for specialist topics. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

kadru.name: Kadru
kadru.about:
Kadru is a compact locality in west-central Ranchi that includes the A. G. Colony, one of the city's established residential colonies. Nearby areas include Ashok Kunj, North Office Para, the Old A G Colony and Harmu. Housing is largely independent houses and small apartment buildings, with some offices and shops along the main roads.

Argora railway station is the nearest station and Ranchi Junction is also within easy reach, which helps tutors coming from other parts of the city by train and auto. The Kadru–Kumhartoli Road links the area to Harmu. Most homes are houses or small buildings without formal gate security, so doorstep visits are straightforward, although parking in narrow lanes can be tight and a two-wheeler is the easier option. Evening sessions are simpler to keep on time if the tutor avoids the office rush on the main roads. Online classes are an easy add-on for specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

pundag.name: Pundag
pundag.about:
Pundag is a growing residential locality in south-west Ranchi, next to Rishabh Nagar, Harmu and Chaputoli, with Argora close by. Much of its housing is newer apartment buildings with three-bedroom flats, along with residential plots and independent houses sold on resale. Pundag Road connects it with Harmu Housing Colony.

Argora railway station is the nearest station, and Ranchi Junction is further away across the city. Residents describe the area as calmer than the centre. Many families here live in apartment enclaves where visitors register at the gate, so it helps to share the tutor's details in advance, while houses on plotted streets allow doorstep access. Tutors coming from Harmu, Argora or Doranda usually travel by two-wheeler or auto. Because homes are spread out towards the edge of the city, families looking for a specialist subject tutor often combine home visits with online classes. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

ratu-road.name: Ratu Road
ratu-road.about:
Ratu Road is the corridor running north-west from central Ranchi, forking from Circular Road beyond Kutchery, with neighbourhoods such as Piska More and Vikas Nagar along it. Shops and offices line the main road, while the lanes behind have independent houses, residential plots and newer apartment buildings with mostly three-bedroom flats. Kanke Road runs parallel to the east.

The Ratu Road elevated corridor, opened in July 2025, carries through traffic above the road from near Raj Bhavan past Piska More, easing movement along the ground-level road. Argora railway station and Ranchi Junction are the nearest stations. Residents mention good public transport and easy auto and cab availability. For tutor visits, houses in the side lanes allow doorstep access, while apartment buildings ask visitors to sign in at the gate. The main road still gets busy around office hours, so evening sessions work better with a little buffer. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

doranda.name: Doranda
doranda.about:
Doranda is one of Ranchi's older districts, south of the city centre, and one of its main business areas alongside Lalpur and Hindpiri. Around its markets are residential pockets such as South Office Para, North Office Para and Shyamali Colony, with housing made up of older independent houses, government and staff colonies, and apartment buildings with two- and three-bedroom flats. Hinoo lies to the west and Namkum further east.

Residents rate Doranda well for public transport, easy auto and cab availability and markets within walking distance. Ranchi Junction and Argora railway station are the nearest stations, and the main road through Doranda links the centre with Hinoo, the airport side and Namkum. For tutors, staff colonies and apartment buildings may ask visitors to register at the gate, while houses in the office para areas allow doorstep visits. Market roads get busy in the evening, so sessions slightly before or after the rush are easier to keep on time. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

hinoo.name: Hinoo
hinoo.about:
Hinoo is a residential area in south Ranchi and the location of the city's airport, which occupies a large part of its land. The housing around it is mostly independent houses and small apartment buildings in colonies such as Shukla Colony and Kilburn Colony. Doranda and Hindpiri, two busy commercial areas, are close by, and Argora lies to the north-west.

Residents rate Hinoo well for public transport, easy cab and auto availability and markets within walking distance. Argora railway station and Ranchi Junction are the nearest stations, and a short run along the High Court Campus Road side links Hinoo to the station area. Most homes are houses with doorstep access, so tutor visits are simple, though apartment buildings may keep a visitor register. Roads near the airport and Doranda get busy at peak hours, so after-school sessions are easier with a little buffer. Online classes suit specialist subjects. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

dhurwa.name: Dhurwa (HEC area)
dhurwa.about:
Dhurwa is the south-western part of Ranchi built around the HEC Colony, the planned township of the public sector heavy engineering plant set up in 1958. The township is laid out in sectors, with company quarters, independent houses and residential plots, and newer apartment buildings in the affordable range. The area also includes the Dhurwa dam and the international cricket stadium, which sits within the HEC premises.

Dhurwa is close to the Bypass Road and the national highway towards the west, and the airport side is reached along Dhurwa Road. Hatia railway station is the nearest station. Residents rate the area well for public transport and easy cab and auto availability and describe the roads as less congested than the centre. The township's wide sector roads make parking and doorstep visits easy, though some colonies ask visitors to sign in. On cricket match days, roads near the stadium fill up, so families may switch to an online session. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

hatia.name: Hatia
hatia.about:
Hatia is a suburb in the south-west of Ranchi, historically named after a market and today widely known for Hatia railway station and the heavy engineering plant set up in the area. The infrastructure built for the plant gave Hatia a large, well-kept residential setting, with staff colonies and independent houses, and newer apartment buildings in the surrounding localities. Dhurwa and the HEC Colony adjoin it, and Tupudana lies to the south-east.

Hatia railway station, on the Ranchi division of the South Eastern Railway, serves the south of the city and is a terminal and transit point for several trains, so tutors coming from other parts of Ranchi can use train and auto for the last leg. The suburb is quieter than the centre, and most homes are houses or low-rise buildings with doorstep access and easy parking, while some colonies ask visitors to sign in. Roads towards the city centre get busier around office hours, so evening sessions are easier to keep on time with a little buffer. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

tupudana.name: Tupudana
tupudana.about:
Tupudana is on the southern edge of Ranchi along the Ranchi–Khunti road, and is home to one of the city's industrial areas, developed in two phases by the state industrial development authority. Around it are residential pockets such as Choybasatoli and River View Colony, with Hatia to the north-west. Housing is mostly newer apartment enclaves with three-bedroom flats, along with residential plots and independent houses.

The Ranchi Ring Road passes close to Tupudana, and Hatia railway station and the airport side are within easy reach by road. Cab and bike-taxi services operate in the area, and a biodiversity park lies nearby. Residents describe the setting as fresh and green. Because homes are spread out, tutors usually travel by their own two-wheeler, and gated enclaves typically ask visitors to register at the entrance while houses allow doorstep access. Families here who want a specialist tutor for a particular board or exam often combine a local home tutor with online classes. Home tutors from nearby areas and online tutors are available on NXTutors, with a free demo class.

Kanke Road, Morabadi & Bariatu.fact: Kanke Road and Ratu Road are the two roads that fork off Circular Road beyond Kutchery in central Ranchi.
Kanke has a large water reservoir, Kanke Dam, which supplies water to Ranchi city; Kanke is a census town in the Kanke CD block of Ranchi Sadar subdivision.
Morhabadi (Morabadi) is a residential neighbourhood in Ranchi that houses the Morhabadi Maidan.
The Ranchi Ring Road and the Kanke–Patratu Road connect the Kanke Road locality with the rest of the city and other parts of Jharkhand.
Bajra–Bariatu Road and Joda Talab Road are the key connecting roads of Bariatu (PIN 834009).
Morabadi (PIN 834008) is served by Morabadi Road, Circular Road, Karamtoli Road, the Kanke–Patratu Road and the Bajra–Bariatu Road.

Lalpur, Kokar & Namkum.fact: Lalpur Chowk is the intersection of Circular Road and Old Hazaribagh Road; Lalpur has PIN code 834001.
Ranchi's main business districts are Lalpur, Hindpiri, Lower Bazaar, Upper Bazaar and Doranda.
Kokar, Tatisilwai and Namkum are among the industrial areas managed by the Jharkhand Industrial Area Development Authority (JIADA).
The 2.4 km Kantatoli flyover was inaugurated on 4 October 2024, after construction began in 2018.
Ranchi Junction opened in 1908 and is the headquarters of the Ranchi division of the South Eastern Railway, with six platforms.
Namkon railway station lies on the Gomoh–Hatia line in the Ranchi division of the South Eastern Railway.
Namkum is a community development block in the Ranchi Sadar subdivision of Ranchi district.

Harmu, Argora & Ratu Road.fact: Harmu Housing Colony, one of the largest residential areas of Ranchi, was established in the early 1960s and lies along Bypass Road (Harmu Road).
Ashok Nagar is a cooperative society colony established in 1975 by senior state government employees.
Argora railway station (code AOR) is in Ranchi district on the South Eastern Railway zone.
The 4.18 km Ratu Road elevated corridor, built by NHAI, was inaugurated in July 2025.
Harmu is connected via Bypass Road, Kadru–Kumhartoli Road, AG Colony Road and Ashok Nagar Road, with Argora railway station nearby.

Doranda, Hinoo & Hatia.fact: Ranchi's airport is located in Hinoo.
Heavy Engineering Corporation, a central public sector undertaking in Ranchi, was established in 1958 and is situated in Hatia.
Hatia railway station (code HTE) belongs to the Ranchi division of the South Eastern Railway and has three platforms.
The JSCA International Stadium Complex lies within the HEC premises; its first ODI was played on 19 January 2013.
Tupudana Industrial Area, on the Ranchi–Khunti road, was developed by JIADA in two phases.
The Ranchi Ring Road is an 86 km ring road encircling the city, in use since 2008.
